title: SharphyMCPToolsSchema
description: Formal MCP tool schema definitions implemented by Sharphy.Server

tools.name: sharphy_analyze_dump
tools.description: Performs automated Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on Windows (.dmp) and Linux (ELF core dump) crash dumps. Use this tool when diagnosing fatal process crashes, unhandled exceptions, or crashing thread call stacks. Do NOT use for thread deadlock cycles (use 'sharphy_deadlock_detector') or heap memory leaks (use 'sharphy_inspect_heap'). This is a non-destructive, read-only diagnostic inspection.

dumpPath.description: Absolute path to the target memory dump file (.dmp)

tools.name: sharphy_inspect_heap
tools.description: Inspects managed heap allocations, generation sizes (Gen 0/1/2, LOH, POH), fragmentation, and object leak retainers in a memory dump. Use this tool when diagnosing high memory usage, memory leaks, or OutOfMemoryException. Do NOT use for general crash RCA (use 'sharphy_analyze_dump') or thread lock cycles (use 'sharphy_deadlock_detector'). Non-destructive, read-only inspection.

dumpPath.description: Absolute path to the target memory dump file (.dmp)

topObjects.description: Top N object types ranked by total memory size

tools.name: sharphy_deadlock_detector
tools.description: Detects thread synchronization deadlocks and lock contention by traversing CLR SyncBlocks and building a Wait-For Graph (WFG). Use this tool when diagnosing unresponsive or frozen .NET applications suspected of thread lock cycles. Do NOT use for unhandled exception crashes (use 'sharphy_analyze_dump') or heap analysis (use 'sharphy_inspect_heap'). Non-destructive, read-only inspection.

dumpPath.description: Absolute path to the target memory dump file (.dmp)

tools.name: sharphy_decompile_method
tools.description: Decompiles compiled CIL bytecode into idiomatic C# source code using the embedded ILSpy engine. Use this tool when inspecting method logic, lambda expressions, or async state machines of a compiled assembly. Do NOT use for metadata enumeration (use 'sharphy_inspect_metadata') or binary diffing (use 'sharphy_diff_assemblies'). Read-only inspection.

assemblyPath.description: Absolute path to the compiled assembly (.dll/.exe)

typeName.description: Fully qualified type or class name (including namespace)

methodName.description: Name of the target method to decompile

tools.name: sharphy_diff_assemblies
tools.description: Compares two versions of a compiled .NET assembly at the ECMA-335 metadata level to identify added/removed types, API breaking changes, and CIL instruction size shifts. Use this tool when validating library updates, regression testing, or detecting API modifications. Do NOT use for decompiling full method bodies (use 'sharphy_decompile_method'). Read-only comparison.

tools.name: sharphy_inspect_metadata
tools.description: Decodes ECMA-335 metadata tables including TypeDef, MethodDef, FieldDef, custom attributes, P/Invoke imports, and embedded resources. Use this tool when discovering types and member signatures of an assembly without decompiling method bodies. Do NOT use for binary comparisons (use 'sharphy_diff_assemblies'). Read-only inspection.

assemblyPath.description: Absolute path to the compiled assembly (.dll/.exe)

tools.name: sharphy_clean_obfuscation
tools.description: Demangles control flow flattening (CFG demangling), trims dead code and excessive NOP sleds, and analyzes dynamic proxy delegates. Use this tool when reverse engineering obfuscated assemblies to produce a cleaner assembly for analysis. Do NOT use for direct opcode modification (use 'sharphy_patch_il'). Mutates by creating a cleaned assembly at outputPath.

assemblyPath.description: Path to the obfuscated input assembly

outputPath.description: Destination path for the cleaned output assembly

tools.name: sharphy_extract_tokens
tools.description: Safely extracts runtime tokens and types by loading target assemblies inside an isolated collectible AssemblyLoadContext (isCollectible: true). Use this tool when dynamically inspecting types without locking files on disk or polluting the host runtime. Do NOT use for static disassembly without runtime loading (use 'sharphy_inspect_metadata'). Sandboxed read-only execution.

tools.name: sharphy_patch_il
tools.description: Surgically modifies CIL bytecode instructions by replacing target opcodes, adjusting branch targets, and emitting a patched binary. Use this tool when bypassing validation logic, inserting NOP sleds, or altering execution flow. Do NOT use for general obfuscation stripping (use 'sharphy_clean_obfuscation'). Mutates by writing a patched assembly to outputPath.

instructionOffset.description: IL offset of the instruction to replace

newOpCode.description: New CIL OpCode (e.g., Nop, Ldc_I4_1, Ret)

outputPath.description: Destination path for the patched binary

tools.name: sharphy_generate_wrapper
tools.description: Generates strongly-typed C# wrapper source code utilizing .NET 8+ [UnsafeAccessor] attributes to access private members and fields with zero reflection overhead. Use this tool when testing or accessing inaccessible internal/private APIs. Do NOT use for bytecode modification (use 'sharphy_patch_il'). Mutates disk by writing a new C# (.cs) source file to outputPath.
